twin-faq.title: AI Twin questions, answered.
twin-faq.lead: Understand what AI Twin is, what is available today and how consent works.

cards.title: What is an AI Twin?
cards.body: An AI Twin is a digital version of a real person, designed to carry their likeness and voice into new videos. Unlike a generic AI presenter, the identity belongs to a specific authorized person.

cards.title: Is AI Twin available now?
cards.body: Not yet. This page previews the concept. Face cloning, voice cloning and a production-ready digital twin are not available here. You can create product videos today with the available AI presenters and video workflow.

cards.title: How is an AI Twin different from an AI presenter?
cards.body: An AI presenter is a library performer you choose for a video. An AI Twin is designed to represent one real person, with explicit consent and a consistent identity across videos.

cards.title: What will I need to create one?
cards.body: The intended workflow uses approved reference images and audio, explicit permission from the person represented, and a clear scope for how the twin can be used.

cards.title: Can I use my own face and voice?
cards.body: That is the goal of AI Twin, but the capability is not live on this page yet. Do not upload or use another person's likeness or voice without their permission.

cards.title: What can I create today?
cards.body: You can choose an AI presenter, write a product brief, edit a storyboard, generate selected shots and assemble a video in the workspace.

cards.title: How will consent work?
cards.body: The concept requires explicit authorization, a defined scope and the ability to revoke future use. A twin should never be created from someone else's likeness without their permission.
